findings.claim: Re-install with an addon: copy_override scans INSTALLED only while copy_kit records an overwrite in KIT_OVERWRITTEN, so the core migration.md replaces the addon one (addon to .new) or a second backup clobbers the adapted copy; no re-install-with-addon case.
findings.closure: install.sh picks the winning source per destination (addon over core) before copying, one copy_kit per path; new IN case: re-install --fastapi over an adapted fastapi migration.md leaves the addon file in place, the backup byte-identical to the pre-run content, no .new; and an untouched addon file on re-install is neither backed up nor listed as adapted.
